reason: A self-contained Cordis plugin adds a configurable, draggable animated mascot to the bottom-right of the DeepSeek Harness web UI and persists its position locally.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中添加可配置、可拖拽并记忆位置的动画宠物。
summaries.en: Adds a configurable, draggable animated mascot to the DeepSeek Harness web interface and remembers its position locally.

capabilities: Injects an animated GIF mascot into the DeepSeek Harness web UI
Serves a configured GIF asset and JSON configuration endpoint
Reads a configured local GIF file up to the documented size limit
Stores the mascot position in browser localStorage
Provides configurable size, visibility, and accessibility text
